description: Answers a link to send a CSV file or an Excel workbook (.xlsx) to from a shell, as it is on disk, at most 10 MB: use it when the user gives you a file, in place of writing a CSV into createDataset, and for every workbook. Run the command it answers with the path of the file. The upload answers the uploaded file with its id, as createDataset does: add it to a report with addReportDatasheets, a workbook after reading its sheets with getDataset. With datasetId, the file replaces the content of that uploaded file. The link works for 10 minutes and for one file: a file that is refused uses it up, so ask for another. Without a shell, write the CSV into createDataset. At most 20 links a minute per user.

body.description: What the tool creates, changes or sends

datasetId.description: An uploaded file to replace the content of: its `id` from `createDataset`, or a datasheet's `datasetId` in `listReportDatasheets`. The file sent must be of its kind, a CSV for a CSV and a workbook for a workbook, and it keeps its id and name. Only the user who uploaded it may. Omit it to upload a new file.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

name: createDatasetUpload
title: Get a link to upload a file
